auditExceptions.$comment: Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs (npm run audit). Each entry allows one advisory in the production tree until its expiry. Anything not listed here fails the gate.

allow.title: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
allow.reason: No patched image-size exists: the advisory covers <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the latest published version, while metro@0.87.0 (latest) still requires ^1.0.2. react-native is only present because npm auto-installs it as an unused peer of @solana-mobile/*, which reference it exclusively from their index.native.js entry points; Next.js resolves index.js, so metro and image-size are React Native build tooling that is never bundled, served, or executed by this web app. Reachability requires parsing attacker-supplied ICNS/JXL/HEIF files, which this app never does.

allow.title: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
allow.reason: Same unpatchable image-size dependency and same unreachable react-native build-tooling path as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.
